projects_basic.name: projects_basic
projects_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program
FROM projects p
projects_basic.description: One row per project with its identifying fields and basic attributes (canonicalized).

project_members_core.name: project_members_core
project_members_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.country,
  pm.city,
  pm.member_short_name
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_core.description: One row per project member (membership record) exposing member identity, role code, linking project id and institution and key geo/cost fields.

project_member_with_project.name: project_member_with_project
project_member_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role"
FROM project_members_core pm
LEFT JOIN projects_basic p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_member_with_project.description: Denormalized rows joining projects to their project_members so each row represents a member of a specific project with project acronym available for easy filtering.
